method.source: Raw Claude transcripts and Codex rollouts; never capped session_turn_parts.
method.bytes: UTF-8 content text; non-text blocks measured as serialized JSON. Transport envelopes are excluded. No tokenizer ran.
method.percentiles: Sorted byte sizes at floor(p * n), capped at n - 1; empty populations are zero.
method.rereadBytes: Replay estimate: result bytes times later recorded model responses inside this window and native compaction segment. Includes the first request consuming the output; no billing/cache assertion. Server-side pruning and branches are not reconstructed.
method.requests: Claude unique message.id; Codex nonzero last_token_usage deduped by cumulative usage per compaction segment. Missing request identities are counted by line and exposed.
method.truncation: Marker-based lower bound; hidden inner markers are unobservable. byCap populations overlap when several caps fire. Projection-success footers do not count.
method.reruns: Heuristic: next call with the same tool and canonical arguments within the declared seconds after a marked result. Delivery caps/timeouts are ignored; each repeat attaches to at most one prior result. Does not prove truncation caused the repeat. Bytes are the observed repeat result bytes.
method.coverage: Finite initial file-size snapshots; mtime selects candidate files, record timestamps select results/requests. Missing timestamps excluded. Overlapping real paths deduped; distinct copied/forked files are separate transcript observations.
